name: Zoho Cliq
description: Communications and messaging: Zoho's team chat platform with channels, bots, and a REST API covering messages, users, teams and files.
access_notes: Free plan exists (includes up to 100 bots per org); OAuth clients are registered self-serve in the Zoho API Console. Tokens sent as 'Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken {token}'. Bot incoming webhooks use separate per-user webhook tokens (zapikey).
mcp_notes: Official Zoho MCP server (configured at mcp.zoho.com) exposes Cliq tools for channels, messages, users, bots, files, calls, etc. No Composio Zoho Cliq toolkit found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/zoho_cliq.md, /cliq.md and composio.dev/toolkits/zoho_cliq all 404).
uncertainty_notes: Zoho OAuth also supports 'self client' registration for server-to-server scripts, still under the OAuth 2.0 umbrella. Webhook support is via bot 'Webhook bots' (execution_url receiving POSTs) and incoming webhook handlers rather than a standalone webhooks product.

evidence.note: OAuth 2.0: register app in Zoho API Console, authorization-code flow via accounts.zoho.{dc}/oauth/v2/auth, bearer scheme with 'Zoho-oauthtoken' prefix.
REST API v3 (v2 still supported) enabling read/write operations similar to the web client.
Free plan available with bots (100/org) and platform features; paid tiers raise limits.
Webhook bots: Cliq sends HTTP POST events to your execution_url; incoming webhook handlers let external services post into bots.
Official vendor MCP: 'Any AI model or agent can use our official MCP server to access your Cliq data'.
